name: Glucose-Limited Medium (GLM) (PMC11019848)
description: Glucose-Limited Medium (GLM) — a defined medium extracted from Paulay et al. (2024). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Paulay et al. Design of a proteolytic module for improved metabolic modeling of Bacteroides caccae. mSystems (2024). DOI: 10.1128/msystems.00153-24. [PMC11019848]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: was grown in Glucose Limited Medium [GLM; (25)] containing: D-glucose 5 g L−1, bactopeptone 5 g L−1, meat extract 5 g L−1, sodium pyruvate 1 g L−1, sodium succinate 1 g L−1, CaCl2 0.01 g L−1, KH2PO4 0). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: high.
provenance.verification_evidence: B. caccae ATCC 43185 ... was grown in Glucose Limited Medium [GLM; (25)] containing: D-glucose 5 g L−1, bactopeptone 5 g L−1, meat extract 5 g L−1, sodium pyruvate 1 g L−1, sodium succinate 1 g L−1, CaCl2 0.01 g L−1, KH2PO4 0.04 g L−1, K2HPO4 0.04 g L−1, NaCl 0.08 g L−1, tween 80 0.1% (vol/vol), ZnSO4 7H2O, 0.02 g L−1, NaHCO3 0.4 g L−1, L-cysteine HCl 0.5 g L−1, phylloquinone 1·10−6 g L−1, thiamin

Meat extract.citation: Meat extract (Lab-Lemco) composition — Oxoid/BD technical data; Atlas RM, Handbook of Microbiological Media.

Bactopeptone.citation: Peptone = proteolytic digest of animal/plant protein; peptides + free amino acids — Atlas RM, Handbook of Microbiological Media (CRC Press).

provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.notes contains 'Extracted from the primary paper'

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
